engine: Open JTalk 1.11 forced NJD pronunciation / NIT ATR503 M001
voiceAttribution: HTS Working Group / Nagoya Institute of Technology, NIT ATR503 M001 voice; see VOICE-LICENSE.txt
dictionary: NAIST Japanese dictionary; MeCab segmentation bypassed for explicit kana pronunciation
phonemeMethod: One structured NJD feature with explicit pron/read/mora_size; make_label directly converts it through njd2jpcommon. Accent=0 (neutral synthesis), not a verified pitch-accent dictionary.
validation: All-word forced-label audit, exact kana-to-phoneme comparison, PCM energy/duration, encoded MP3 stream, SHA-256. This is not human listening verification.
